name: Oxaloacetate
short: Small trials of 1 to 3 months in Alzheimer's disease and ME/CFS found oxaloacetate safe and well tolerated at the doses tested.
text: In a 1-month trial in people with Alzheimer's disease (15 per group), oxaloacetate at 500 or 1000 mg twice daily was safe and tolerated. In a 3-month randomised, double-blind controlled trial in 82 people with ME/CFS, 2,000 mg per day was well tolerated. Both trials were small and short. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.

quotes: We orally administered 500 or 1000 mg OAA, twice daily for 1 month, to AD participants (n = 15 each group)
Both doses were safe and tolerated.
